{{Quote|He led the Rebel commandos in the assault on the Imperial bunker on Endor, was an important part of the Echo Base command structure on Hoth, and was responsible for saving countless civilian lives at the Battle of Nentan.|Voren Na'al, about Bren Derlin|<ref name="TLCS">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Nentan''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nentan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Rieekan_timeline" /> the planet Nentan was a Rebel [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] for many civilian refugees hoping to find asylum from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and an important checkpoint along Rebel evacuation roads.<ref name="GG3" /> Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] also participated in the operations at Nentan. With the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], she transmitted messages and dispensed much-needed material.<ref name="TEA-" />

==The evacuation==
When the Empire discovered Nentan, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] oversaw the evacuation of the Rebel base and bunkers. The situation was critical due to the low number of transports that was only good enough too evacuate civilians. Rieekan considered to sacrifice most military personnel to save the civilians but the evacuation was successful thanks to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]]. Derlin and a squad of Rebel troops lured Imperial infantry in ancient ruins and managed to steal an insufficiently guarded Imperial transport. This ship was enough to safely evacuate all remaining military personnel from the planet, without even attracting the attention of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in orbit.<ref name="GG3" />

==Aftermath==
After this unexpected successful evacuation, Bren Derlin was promoted to [[Major/Legends|Major]] by General Rieekan and later given command of security and operations of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="GG3" />
